verses.original: בְּ֭נִי שְׁמֹ֣ר אֲמָרָ֑י וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî šə·mōr ’ă·mā·rāy ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay tiṣ·pōn ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: My son keep my words and treasure my commandments within you
verses.literalPt: FILHO meu, guarda as minhas palavras, e esconde dentro de ti os meus mandamentos.

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר מִצְוֺתַ֣י וֶחְיֵ֑ה וְ֝תוֹרָתִ֗י כְּאִישׁ֥וֹן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mōr miṣ·wō·ṯay weḥ·yêh wə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî kə·’î·šō·wn ‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Keep my commandments and live guard my teachings as the apple of your eye
verses.literalPt: Guarda os meus mandamentos e vive; e a minha lei, como a menina dos teus olhos.

verses.original: קָשְׁרֵ֥ם עַל־ אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ כָּ֝תְבֵ֗ם עַל־ ל֥וּחַ לִבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·šə·rêm ‘al- ’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯe·ḵā kā·ṯə·ḇêm ‘al- lū·aḥ lib·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Tie them to your fingers write them on the tablet of your heart
verses.literalPt: Ata-os aos teus dedos, escreve-os na tábua do teu coração.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר לַֽ֭חָכְמָה אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ וּ֝מֹדָ֗ע לַבִּינָ֥ה תִקְרָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr la·ḥā·ḵə·māh ’ă·ḥō·ṯî ’āt ū·mō·ḏā‘ lab·bî·nāh ṯiq·rā
verses.literal: Say to wisdom You are my sister and call understanding your kinsman
verses.literalPt: Dize à sabedoria: Tu és minha irmã; e à prudência chama de tua parenta,

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה זָרָ֑ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃
verses.transliteration: liš·mā·rə·ḵā mê·’iš·šāh zā·rāh min·nā·ḵə·rî·yāh ’ă·mā·re·hā he·ḥĕ·lî·qāh
verses.literal: that they may keep you from the adulteress . . . from the stranger with seductive words
verses.literalPt: Para que elas te guardem da mulher alheia, da estranha que lisonjeia com as suas palavras.

verses.original: כִּ֭י בְּחַלּ֣וֹן בֵּיתִ֑י בְּעַ֖ד אֶשְׁנַבִּ֣י נִשְׁקָֽפְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ḥal·lō·wn bê·ṯî bə·‘aḏ ’eš·nab·bî niš·qā·p̄ə·tî
verses.literal: For at the window of my house I looked through the lattice
verses.literalPt: Porque da janela da minha casa, olhando eu por minhas frestas,

verses.original: וָאֵ֤רֶא בַפְּתָאיִ֗ם אָ֘בִ֤ינָה בַבָּנִ֗ים נַ֣עַר חֲסַר־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re ḇap·pə·ṯā·yim ’ā·ḇî·nāh ḇab·bā·nîm na·‘ar ḥă·sar- lêḇ
verses.literal: I saw among the simple I noticed among the youths a young man lacking judgment
verses.literalPt: Vi entre os simples, descobri entre os moços, um moço falto de juízo,

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ר בַּ֭שּׁוּק אֵ֣צֶל פִּנָּ֑הּ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ בֵּיתָ֣הּ יִצְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·ḇêr baš·šūq ’ê·ṣel pin·nāh wə·ḏe·reḵ bê·ṯāh yiṣ·‘āḏ
verses.literal: crossing the street near her corner strolling down the road to her house
verses.literalPt: Que passava pela rua junto à sua esquina, e seguia o caminho da sua casa;

verses.original: בְּנֶֽשֶׁף־ בְּעֶ֥רֶב י֑וֹם בְּאִישׁ֥וֹן לַ֝֗יְלָה וַאֲפֵלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ne·šep̄- bə·‘e·reḇ yō·wm bə·’î·šō·wn lay·lāh wa·’ă·p̄ê·lāh
verses.literal: at twilight as the day was fading . . . into the dark of the night . . .
verses.literalPt: No crepúsculo, à tarde do dia, na tenebrosa noite e na escuridão.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה אִ֭שָּׁה לִקְרָאת֑וֹ שִׁ֥ית ז֝וֹנָ֗ה וּנְצֻ֥רַת לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’iš·šāh liq·rā·ṯōw šîṯ zō·w·nāh ū·nə·ṣu·raṯ lêḇ
verses.literal: Then a woman came out to meet him with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart
verses.literalPt: E eis que uma mulher lhe saiu ao encontro com enfeites de prostituta, e astúcia de coração.

verses.original: הֹמִיָּ֣ה הִ֣יא וְסֹרָ֑רֶת בְּ֝בֵיתָ֗הּ לֹא־ יִשְׁכְּנ֥וּ רַגְלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·mî·yāh hî wə·sō·rā·reṯ bə·ḇê·ṯāh lō- yiš·kə·nū raḡ·le·hā
verses.literal: She is loud and defiant her feet do not remain at home
verses.literalPt: Estava alvoroçada e irriquieta; não paravam em sua casa os seus pés.

verses.original: פַּ֤עַם׀ בַּח֗וּץ פַּ֥עַם בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת וְאֵ֖צֶל כָּל־ פִּנָּ֣ה תֶאֱרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: pa·‘am ba·ḥūṣ pa·‘am bā·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ wə·’ê·ṣel kāl- pin·nāh ṯe·’ĕ·rōḇ
verses.literal: Now in the street now in the squares she lurks at every corner
verses.literalPt: Foi para fora, depois pelas ruas, e ia espreitando por todos os cantos;

verses.original: וְהֶחֱזִ֣יקָה בּ֭וֹ וְנָ֣שְׁקָה־ לּ֑וֹ הֵעֵ֥זָה פָ֝נֶ֗יהָ וַתֹּ֣אמַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·ḥĕ·zî·qāh bōw wə·nā·šə·qāh- lōw hê·‘ê·zāh p̄ā·ne·hā wat·tō·mar lōw
verses.literal: She seizes him and kisses him she brazenly . . . says to him
verses.literalPt: E chegou-se para ele e o beijou. Com face impudente lhe disse:

verses.original: זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֣ים עָלָ֑י הַ֝יּ֗וֹם שִׁלַּ֥מְתִּי נְדָרָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ziḇ·ḥê šə·lā·mîm ‘ā·lāy hay·yō·wm šil·lam·tî nə·ḏā·rāy
verses.literal: I have made my peace . . . offerings today I have paid my vows
verses.literalPt: Sacrifícios pacíficos tenho comigo; hoje paguei os meus votos.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן יָצָ֣אתִי לִקְרָאתֶ֑ךָ לְשַׁחֵ֥ר פָּ֝נֶ֗יךָ וָאֶמְצָאֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên yā·ṣā·ṯî liq·rā·ṯe·ḵā lə·ša·ḥêr pā·ne·ḵā wā·’em·ṣā·’e·kā
verses.literal: So . . . I came out to meet you I sought you . . . and I have found you
verses.literalPt: Por isto saí ao teu encontro a buscar diligentemente a tua face, e te achei.

verses.original: מַ֭רְבַדִּים רָבַ֣דְתִּי עַרְשִׂ֑י חֲ֝טֻב֗וֹת אֵט֥וּן מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mar·ḇad·dîm rā·ḇaḏ·tî ‘ar·śî ḥă·ṭu·ḇō·wṯ ’ê·ṭūn miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: I have decked my bed with coverings with colored linen from Egypt
verses.literalPt: Já cobri a minha cama com cobertas de tapeçaria, com obras lavradas, com linho fino do Egito.

verses.original: נַ֥פְתִּי מִשְׁכָּבִ֑י מֹ֥ר אֲ֝הָלִ֗ים וְקִנָּמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·tî miš·kā·ḇî mōr ’ă·hā·lîm wə·qin·nā·mō·wn
verses.literal: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh with aloes and with cinnamon
verses.literalPt: Já perfumei o meu leito com mirra, aloés e canela.

verses.original: לְכָ֤ה נִרְוֶ֣ה דֹ֭דִים עַד־ הַבֹּ֑קֶר נִ֝תְעַלְּסָ֗ה בָּאֳהָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵāh nir·weh ḏō·ḏîm ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer niṯ·‘al·lə·sāh bā·’o·hā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Come let us take our fill of love till morning Let us delight in loving caresses
verses.literalPt: Vem, saciemo-nos de amores até à manhã; alegremo-nos com amores.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין הָאִ֣ישׁ בְּבֵית֑וֹ הָ֝לַ֗ךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מֵרָחֽוֹק׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ên hā·’îš bə·ḇê·ṯōw hā·laḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ mê·rā·ḥō·wq
verses.literal: For my husband is not at home he has gone on a long journey
verses.literalPt: Porque o marido não está em casa; foi fazer uma longa viagem;

verses.original: צְֽרוֹר־ הַ֭כֶּסֶף לָקַ֣ח בְּיָד֑וֹ לְי֥וֹם הַ֝כֵּ֗סֶא יָבֹ֥א בֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣə·rō·wr- hak·ke·sep̄ lā·qaḥ bə·yā·ḏōw lə·yō·wm hak·kê·se yā·ḇō ḇê·ṯōw
verses.literal: He took with him a bag of money and will not return . . . till the moon is full
verses.literalPt: Levou na sua mão um saquitel de dinheiro; voltará para casa só no dia marcado.

verses.original: הִ֭טַּתּוּ בְּרֹ֣ב לִקְחָ֑הּ בְּחֵ֥לֶק שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗יהָ תַּדִּיחֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hiṭ·ṭat·tū bə·rōḇ liq·ḥāh bə·ḥê·leq śə·p̲ā·t̲ê·hā tad·dî·ḥen·nū
verses.literal: With her great persuasion she entices him with her flattering lips she lures him
verses.literalPt: Assim, o seduziu com palavras muito suaves e o persuadiu com as lisonjas dos seus lábios.

verses.original: ה֤וֹלֵ֥ךְ אַחֲרֶ֗יהָ פִּ֫תְאֹ֥ם כְּ֭שׁוֹר אֶל־ טָ֣בַח יָב֑וֹא וּ֝כְעֶ֗כֶס אֶל־ מוּסַ֥ר אֱוִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ ’a·ḥă·re·hā piṯ·’ōm kə·šō·wr ’el- ṭå̄·ḇaḥ yā·ḇō·w ū·ḵə·‘e·ḵes ’el- mū·sar ’ĕ·wîl
verses.literal: He follows her . . . on impulse like an ox going to the slaughter like a deer bounding into a trap
verses.literalPt: E ele logo a segue, como o boi que vai para o matadouro, e como vai o insensato para o castigo das prisões;

verses.original: עַ֤ד יְפַלַּ֪ח חֵ֡ץ כְּֽבֵד֗וֹ כְּמַהֵ֣ר צִפּ֣וֹר אֶל־ פָּ֑ח וְלֹֽא־ יָ֝דַ֗ע כִּֽי־ בְנַפְשׁ֥וֹ הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ yə·p̄al·laḥ ḥêṣ kə·ḇê·ḏōw kə·ma·hêr ṣip·pō·wr ’el- pāḥ wə·lō- yā·ḏa‘ kî- ḇə·nap̄·šōw hū
verses.literal: until an arrow pierces his liver like a bird darting into a snare not knowing . . . it will cost him his life
verses.literalPt: Até que a flecha lhe atravesse o fígado; ou como a ave que se apressa para o laço, e não sabe que está armado contra a sua vida.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבוּ לְאִמְרֵי־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî wə·haq·šî·ḇū lə·’im·rê- p̄î
verses.literal: Now my sons listen to me and attend to the words of my mouth
verses.literalPt: Agora pois, filhos, dai-me ouvidos, e estai atentos às palavras da minha boca.

verses.original: אַל־ יֵ֣שְׂטְ אֶל־ דְּרָכֶ֣יהָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ אַל־ תֵּ֝תַע בִּנְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- yê·śəṭ ’el- də·rā·ḵe·hā lib·be·ḵā ’al- tê·ṯa‘ bin·ṯî·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways do not stray into her paths
verses.literalPt: Não se desvie para os caminhos dela o teu coração, e não te deixes perder nas suas veredas.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רַבִּ֣ים חֲלָלִ֣ים הִפִּ֑ילָה וַ֝עֲצֻמִ֗ים כָּל־ הֲרֻגֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rab·bîm ḥă·lā·lîm hip·pî·lāh wa·‘ă·ṣu·mîm kāl- hă·ru·ḡe·hā
verses.literal: For she has brought many down to death her slain are many in number
verses.literalPt: Porque a muitos feridos derrubou; e são muitíssimos os que por causa dela foram mortos.

verses.original: דַּרְכֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל בֵּיתָ֑הּ יֹ֝רְד֗וֹת אֶל־ חַדְרֵי־ מָֽוֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: dar·ḵê šə·’ō·wl bê·ṯāh yō·rə·ḏō·wṯ ’el- ḥaḏ·rê- mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Her house is the road to Sheol descending to the chambers of death
verses.literalPt: A sua casa é caminho do inferno que desce para as câmaras da morte.
